extra.final_summary: Fixed two data-quality issues relevant to the question: (1) normalized island label variants " Biscoe"/"Biscoe " into "Biscoe" (3 cells), and (2) removed 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 7, 11) that would otherwise double-count penguins in the average. Left flipper_length_mm (−187) and body_mass_g (e.g. 3800000) out-of-range values untouched since those columns are not used by this question. Result — average bill length by island for Adelie penguins: Biscoe 38.80 mm, Dream 37.43 mm, Torgersen 39.39 mm (20 rows used).
